title: The Sinking of the Left Side of the Bed
core_theme: The persistent physical topography of a missing mass.
narrative_spec: Examine the permanent indentation left on a mattress by a body that is no longer there. Breakup? Death, Murder? Does it matter? It is gone. You are alone. The mattress knows.

title: The Taxonomy of the Uncallable Contact
core_theme: The digital preservation of an obsolete destination.
narrative_spec: Focus on the fright of the flash of a lost lovers name through your eyes

title: The Architecture of the Half-Cleared Closet
core_theme: The violent transition from shared life to individual inventory.
narrative_spec: Set the poem within the interior of a wardrobe where one person's clothes have been packed away.

title: Litany for the Leftover Prescription
core_theme: The chemical remnants of a concluded battle.
narrative_spec: Analyze an orange plastic pharmacy bottle containing leftover pills sitting in a bathroom cabinet weeks after an illness has ended.

title: The Dialectics of the 7:15 AM Ghost-Routine
core_theme: The involuntary muscle memory of joint existence.
narrative_spec: Consider a ritual that is marred by the absence of the person who once shared it

title: The Geometry of the Unopened Letter
narrative_spec: Deconstruct a letter or card received that you are frightened to open... what other emotions are present?

title: The Silt of the Unused Voice
core_theme: The physical decay of speech during protracted silence.
narrative_spec: Explore the physical sensation of speaking with another human after the mind has ran its marathon.

title: The Shipwreck in the Shared Playlist
core_theme: The acoustic curation of a lost era.
narrative_spec: Anatomy of an algorithmic music playlist created collaboratively during a relationship that has since collapsed. Did you even like those artists??? Yuck.

title: The Taxonomy of the Voicemail Archive
core_theme: The mechanical loop as a false resurrection.
narrative_spec: Lets test your ability to be open. Examine something you keep coming back to, something you know maybe you shouldn't, reframe it, help me help yourself.

title: The Epistemology of the Unused Coat Hook
core_theme: The structural mourning of a domestic fixture.
narrative_spec: think about the spaces outside in the world that our ours, the coat hooks we frequent, lockers, parking spots... how might they feel without you?

title: The Footprint in the Hallway Carpet
core_theme: The slow elastic memory of industrial textiles.
narrative_spec: When was the last time you left a space for the last time, knowingly, unknowingly. Did you leave a mark or go quietly?

title: The Calibration of the Cold Radiator
core_theme: The thermal subtraction of domestic comfort.

title: The Protocol of the Unsent Draft
core_theme: The preservation of urgent text within a digital quarantine.
narrative_spec: Examine the text block inside an email or text message application that was written during a crisis of longing but never sent.

title: The Interrogation of the Shared Book Margin
core_theme: The textual haunting of an inherited library.
narrative_spec: How does the physical presence of handwriting affect you... personally or otherwise?

title: The Sinking Index of the Emergency Contact
core_theme: The legal vulnerability of modern isolation.
narrative_spec: A person must fill out an official medical form or employment document and arrives at the box labeled 'In Case of Emergency.' Reframe the blank line not as an administrative step, but as a vast, white desert where the speaker realizes they have no legal protector left in the city, their safety net having unraveled into the dark.

title: The Sovereignty of the Half-Told Anecdote
core_theme: The slow death of an internal cultural reference.
narrative_spec: Explore the sudden freezing of a speaker’s conversation when they begin to tell an inside joke or reference a shared experience that only the missing person would understand. Reframe the incomplete story as an exotic animal that cannot survive outside the specific ecosystem of two minds, dying mid-sentence on the floor of a crowded room.

title: The Taxonomy of the Unused Airline Credit
core_theme: The monetization of a canceled future.
narrative_spec: Reflect on an opportunity that was sorely not taken... impart wisdom gently... or not

title: The Last Step of the Front Porch Liturgy
core_theme: The spatial memory of a final embrace.
narrative_spec: Set the importance of a conversation you will never forget... a moment that has become you.
